Michael Erard

About the author

Michael Erard is an author and linguist. Formerly based in the US, he now lives in the Netherlands with his family. His writing has appeared in The Atlantic, the New York Times, Science, Aeon, New Scientist, the European Review of Books, and many other publications. His second book, Babel No More, has been translated into 8 languages. He is a researcher at the Centre for Language Studies at Radboud University.
